title: Study Hack #3: a 3-line email to your teacher
cta: Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens · link in bio

items: Say hi and who you are.

lines.t: is a skill. Not a flaw.

copy.caption: Nervous about emailing a teacher? Three lines is enough: say hi and who you are, ask one clear question, say thanks. Short and clear is easier to answer. Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens (30 short sessions, 6 skills): link in bio.

copy.pin_title: How to Email a Teacher: A Simple 3-Line Template for Teens
